summary: Full backend+frontend validation of the support-chat / DonationAlerts / Telegram review request against the public preview URL. Isolated backend suite: 301 pass (-m 'not live'). New live suite tests/test_live_support_payments.py (17 tests, all pass) covers: language-aware welcome (EN/RU via X-Lang), screenshot uploads (401 guest, 400 non-image, 413 >1MB, 201 valid PNG returning attachment_id+expires_at, GET private for owner, 404 for other user, admin GET works, 429 20s-cooldown), DonationAlerts request creation (URL/currency/amount/code/roblox nick present, 409 while pending), 'I paid' once (200 then 409, 404 for other user), Telegram webhook secret (403 no header, 200 with correct sha256[:48]), simulated callbacks (stranger id ignored, 'da:ask' does not credit, 'da:ok' credits & flips deposit to confirmed, re-delivered update_id is idempotent, 'da:rej'/'da:rejok' reject path). UI smoke on /en: donation form (donation-form, donation-currency-USD/EUR, donation-amount-input, card-support-button) all visible under Top up -> Money -> rub-method-card; chat-attach-button + hidden chat-attach-input render once chat.chat is loaded for a logged-in user; admin-telegram-card visible on /admin Chats tab; my-request-donation rows show 'DonationAlerts · 5.00 USD' in Requests -> Completed. Real 'I paid' pressed exactly ONCE (as required). No call to /api/admin/telegram/setup. Money-safety code (confirm_deposit / bank / spin / drop) was NOT modified.

issues: DonationAlerts request card subtitle still contains Russian word 'код' when the site language is English: 'DonationAlerts · 5 USD · код BG-XXXXXX'. Should be 'code'. Screenshot in /tmp/ui_req2.png.

action_items: Minor i18n leak: replace 'код' with 'code' (or use the existing translator) in the Requests list subtitle for donationalerts deposits when lang=en. Likely in frontend/src/components/topup requests list where the subtitle is built.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~2975 lines — consider modularising chats/deposits/admin (already noted last iteration).

backend/.env CHAT_ATTACHMENTS_MAX_MB=1024 is the total-cap (5 GB DB budget); per-file 1 MB is hardcoded in chat_attachments.MAX_BYTES — the two names look confusable, consider renaming to CHAT_ATTACHMENTS_TOTAL_CAP_MB for clarity (non-blocking).
PyJWT InsecureKeyLengthWarning persists (16-byte HMAC key interpretation) — cosmetic; effective secret is 32 raw bytes if decoded from hex.
